FND-0148.statement: Let U be a connected quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme over a field k, u a geometric point, and Z -> U a finite etale right S_6-torsor. The group H in Irr(Z) = H\S_6 for the k-scheme Z is the image H_arith of pi_1^{et}(U,u) -> S_6. If U is normal, integral, and locally Noetherian, connected components of Z are its irreducible components, indexed by left H_arith-cosets; each has degree |H_arith| over U and stabilizer conjugate to H_arith. If, in addition, U_{k-bar} is connected, then H_geom := image(pi_1^{et}(U_{k-bar},u) -> S_6) is normal in H_arith, [S_6:H_arith] <= [S_6:H_geom], and after base change Z has [S_6:H_geom] geometric irreducible components of degree |H_geom|. Thus irreducibility over k is weaker than geometric irreducibility. This identifies the group but does not compute either monodromy image for the balanced tetragonal family.

hypotheses: U connected qcqs over a field k
Z -> U a finite etale right S_6-torsor
U normal integral locally Noetherian for Irr(Z) = pi_0(Z)
U_{k-bar} connected for H_geom normal in H_arith and the geometric component count

FND-0149.statement: Let k be a characteristic-zero field and S a locally Noetherian k-scheme, reduced where Grauert is used and locally of finite type where base change to k-bar must remain locally Noetherian. The ATT-0088 conclusions concerning AJ = P_S(pi_*L), nonemptiness of the distinct-support open, the finite etale S_6-ordering torsor, S-smoothness of relative dimension two, and the codimension-four regular immersion descend from k-bar to k: the fibrewise hypotheses are geometric, cohomology dimensions are invariant under field extension, and the relevant morphism properties are fpqc-local on the target. This widening does not preserve the monodromy label: over non-algebraically-closed k, the component formula uses arithmetic monodromy as specified in FND-0148.

scope.ground_field: characteristic-zero field k, not necessarily algebraically closed
scope.base: S locally Noetherian over k; reduced where Grauert is used; locally of finite type where S_{k-bar} must remain locally Noetherian
does_not_widen_unchanged: the monodromy image in the S_6 component formula
